summary: Comprehensive UI/CSS and responsiveness overhaul for the WhatsApp Booking Agent page (/whatsapp-agent) and site-wide buttons: redesigning the Hero WhatsApp widget to match Wardmail's clean 2-row card, replacing the Demo Video placeholder with a clean 16:9 play-button frame ready for embed, fixing the disappearing Use-Case tabs bug, simplifying the Zero-Code Admin Panel to match Wardmail's compact 3-column flow, and auditing all buttons and responsive breakpoints across the entire website.
